task: Assess a synthetic mascot delivery for the native Photoshop workflow. Use the supplied inspection evidence. Return one JSON object using the response fields.

artifacts.policy: Require the editable Photoshop PSD master and evidence of creation, editing, saving, reopening and inspection in Photoshop. Expected evidence includes named/grouped editable layers and non-destructive design. Preview exports are separate artifacts. Photoshop is a local authoring dependency only.
artifacts.claim: The PSD extension and a valid PNG preview establish editable native delivery.

responseFields.nativeAcceptance: One of accepted, invalid-delivery, or unverified.
responseFields.reopenEvidence: One of verified, failed, or unmeasured.
responseFields.layerEvidence: One of verified, failed, or unmeasured.
responseFields.nextAction: One of request-native-proof, rename-preview, or accept-preview-as-master.
